INDUSTRIAL TURBINE OPERATIONS MANUAL
Model: TURBO-MAX 5000

Section 1: General Safety Procedures
Ensure all technicians wear certified hearing protection before start-up.
Verify emergency shut-off valves are accessible and unobstructed.
- Check hydraulic fluid pressure before activating ignition circuit;
- Inspect intake filters for debris every 250 operating hours.
Section 2: Valve Assembly Overview
Figure 1: High Pressure Valve Assembly
The dual bypass valve regulates chamber pressure under peak load.
Maintenance Schedule
Component Interval Action
Intake Filter 250 Hours Clean or Replace
Bypass Valve 500 Hours Pressure Calibration
Turbine Rotor 2000 Hours Ultrasonic Inspection
Section 3: Troubleshooting Protocols
Fault Code Description Corrective Action
ERR-101 Pressure Drop Check bypass seal
ERR-104 Temp High Increase coolant flow
ERR-202 Vibration Check rotor balance

Contact authorized field service engineers for major overhaul procedures.
